name: kid-mind
description: The kid's mind: the same three neurons as Max's, with her own feelings and her own lines. A character is a network; changing the folder changes the character.

neurons.description: Keeps the words she just heard (the cue's line, or Max's answer) as { heard }.
Decides what the words did to her: stung, warm or steady.
Answers once she has both the words and the feeling; { say, pose } - her line and her face.
